messages:
sophie_support: Forwarding customer report — says they tried to apply promo code 'SPRING-EXTEND-50' when requesting a trial extension and the API returned an invalid/expired error. Customer email: user@example.com, account_id: acct_1234. They say the same code worked earlier this week. Can someone take a look?

matt_engineer: Thanks — can you paste the exact API request/response or a screenshot from the dashboard? Also was the code copied from an email or entered manually?

sophie_support: From our request logs:
```
POST /v1/promos/apply
{"code":"SPRING-EXTEND-50","account_id":"acct_1234"}
```
Response: 400 {"error":"promo_invalid_or_expired","message":"Code invalid or expired"}
The dashboard for the promo shows `valid_until: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z` and it lists `applies_to_trial_extension: true`. Customer says they received the code via marketing email.

matt_engineer: Hmm — dashboard TTL is after today so expiry doesn't explain it. Possible normalization/signature mismatch or an eligibility flag. @kevin_billing can you check promo metadata and last modifications?

kevin_billing: Looking now — promo id `promo_5421` name 'Spring Extend 50%'. Metadata: eligibility tiers = [starter,growth], applies_to_trial_extension = true, last_modified = 2026-02-28T14:03:12Z by maria_ops. No partner-only flag, no manual deactivation.

matt_engineer: I pulled promo-service validation logs for code 'SPRING-EXTEND-50'. Found this entry: 2026-03-02T03:12:17Z — validation failed in canonicalization: code read from DB contained a non-breaking space (U+00A0) between SPRING-EXTEND and 50; user input contained regular space. Signature check compared raw bytes and failed -> returned invalid. Looks like a legacy CSV import inserted NBSP.

sophie_support: Oh interesting — so the code in DB isn't strictly ASCII-space. Can we accept NBSP on input side as a quick fix? Customer needs immediate help.

matt_engineer: Quick mitigation: add tolerant normalization on the validator to map NBSP -> regular space before signature/sanitization. I'll push a small patch to promo-service and can manually apply the code for this account in the meantime.

kevin_billing: I can do the manual grant now. Applying a one-off 30-credit promo to acct_1234 (internal txn id txn_7890). Ticket created: CS-5567. Notified customer that we've applied credits and are fixing the service.

matt_engineer: Deploying canary for the normalization patch (will accept both ASCII space and NBSP). After canary, I'll run a smoke: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply -d '{"code":"SPRING-EXTEND-50","account_id":"acct_1234"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'`

ops-bot: deploy-canary: matt_engineer pushed commit 5e4f2d to promo-service. Canary rollout started (10% traffic).

sophie_support: Customer replied: they saw the manual credit and then retried pasted code from the email; it succeeded in the dashboard and their trial extended. They said thanks and appreciated the quick fix. :tada:

matt_engineer: Root cause summary for postmortem notes: legacy CSV importer had non-breaking spaces (U+00A0) in some promo codes. Validation used raw bytes for signature check so user-entered regular spaces didn't match. Fixes deployed: 1) add input canonicalization normalize NBSP->space; 2) migration script to normalize existing codes in DB and re-generate signatures where required; 3) add unit tests for unicode whitespace; 4) add monitoring alert for promo validation error spikes. I'll open a PR with changelog and migration plan.

kevin_billing: Manual credit applied and migration job scheduled. I'll follow up with finance if any downstream reconciliation needed (txn_7890). Assigning postmortem to eng-oncall to review ingestion pipeline.

sophie_support: :white_check_mark: Updating ticket CS-5567 with timeline, credit txn id, and root-cause. Replying to customer with a short explanation and apology. Will mark resolved after migration runs.
